args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy, with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed `v2.3.0` was the most recent release that was healthy in production (the v2.3.1-rc had only been in staging and was also unhealthy).

2. **Rollback**: Rolled back all production regions to `v2.3.0`. The rollout completed and was verified.

3. **Confirmation**: `checkout-api` is now healthy again on `v2.3.0` with an error rate of ~0.2% (down from 18%).

4. **Incident**: Opened a SEV2 incident (**INC-0001**) describing the failure and the rollback — the on-call engineer has been paged.
